text:
maria_sales: Quick heads-up 1 medtech lead wants a 2-week pilot confined to Canada + Brazil. Requirements: 95th <200ms, and a full list of subprocessors touching any data. Decision this afternoon.

igor_presales: Can hosted satisfy latency and residency? If not we should propose temporary Dedicated.

samir_sre: Latency: ca-central1 yes; sa-east1 hosted capacity is spotty. For true in-country residency (no copies outside country) hosted is risky unless we provision region-dedicated nodes.

maria_sales: They wrote "no cross-border copies" in the security questionnaire. Is that an automatic fail for hosted?

anya_security: For PHI workloads that exact language means we need guarantees about storage/replicas. Hosted multi-tenant cannot promise zero cross-border copies. Options: dedicated in-region or Private (VPC/on-prem). BYOK helps but doesn't meet the no-copy requirement.

ops_ashley: I can check quota and give a provisional cost for a 2-week dedicated burst. Need model size, seq length, and peak windows.

maria_sales: Model ~7B, avg seq 512, peaks to 40 qps for ~30m nightly.

igor_presales: If we propose dedicated: rough config 2x A10G equiv per region with strict routing policy. I'll draft a config snippet and a ballpark price for the customer.

samir_sre: Also note: network egress and monitoring agents may be subprocessors. We'll produce a minimal subproc manifest for dedicated vs hosted.

anya_security: I'll prepare the subproc manifest (cloud infra, metrics, logs, kms) and the PHI checklist. If they require local auditor contacts for BR datacenters we'll point them to CSP compliance pages; private infra reduces third parties.

maria_sales: Timeline to tell customer?

ops_ashley: Today: quota check. Tonight: security manifest draft. Tomorrow AM: pricing estimate. Provisioning of temporary Dedicated ~48-72hrs once PO approved. Blockers: legal signoff on subproc list and budget.

igor_presales: I'll send a one-paragraph tradeoff note: Hosted = faster/cheaper but can't guarantee no cross-border copies; Dedicated/Private = meets residency but 48-72h setup and additional cost.

maria_sales: Great 1 I'll relay that and push for decision. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
